description: Decode unknown transaction calldata: find the function signature and decode the arguments. Looks up the selector (built-in list, then openchain / 4byte), tries each candidate signature and keeps the first one that decodes and re-encodes to exactly the same bytes, so collisions are filtered out. Returns the function, arguments and the other candidates. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
